title: Python SDK client-side checks that raise: PRA credentials and approval times, and custom control rules
aliases: Start time cannot be more than 1 hour in the past

prose.text: These are claims about checks the Python SDK runs before sending. Most of them raise an exception, so a call that fails here never reaches the error slot.

prose.label: PRA approvals.
prose.text: {{approval-times-checked}} {{approval-times-both-needed}} How the optional working hours are sent is in [[zpa.pra.tooling]].

checks.do: Whether a credential or approval call raised before sending, and was wrapped in a try block, since these checks raise ValueError.
Whether an SSH key passed the SDK check only because it contained a PEM header, which says nothing about the key being usable.

credential-type-raises.statement: `add_credential` and `update_credential` raise ValueError, rather than returning it, when username or password is missing for USERNAME_PASSWORD, when username or private key is missing for SSH_KEY, when the password is missing for PASSWORD, and for any other `credential_type`.

quotes: raise ValueError("Username and password must be provided for USERNAME_PASSWORD type.")
raise ValueError("Username and private_key must be provided for SSH_KEY type.")
raise ValueError("Password must be provided for PASSWORD type.")
raise ValueError("Username and password must be provided for USERNAME_PASSWORD type.")
raise ValueError("Username and private_key must be provided for SSH_KEY type.")
raise ValueError("Password must be provided for PASSWORD type.")

ssh-key-check.statement: The SSH key check accepts any text that contains one of the headers `-----BEGIN OPENSSH PRIVATE KEY-----`, `-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----` or `-----BEGIN EC PRIVATE KEY-----`; it does not parse the key.

quotes: return any(re.search(pattern, private_key) for pattern in ssh_key_patterns)

approval-times-checked.statement: The PRA approval time conversion raises ValueError for a time zone that is not in the pytz list, for a start time more than one hour in the past, and for an end time more than 365 days after the start.

quotes: raise ValueError("Start time cannot be more than 1 hour in the past.")
raise ValueError("Start time and end time range cannot exceed 1 year.")
Invalid time zone. Please visit the following site for reference

approval-times-both-needed.statement: `add_approval` converts times only when both `start_time` and `end_time` are given, using the working hours time zone or UTC, and then sends epoch `startTime` and `endTime`; `update_approval` makes the same call.

custom-control-rule-shape.statement: `add_custom_control` rebuilds each rule from its `type`, optional `names` and each condition's `lhs`, `op` and `rhs`, raising TypeError for a rule that is not a dictionary and KeyError for a rule or condition missing those keys; other keys on a rule are dropped.

quotes: raise TypeError(f"Expected rule to be a dictionary, got {type(rule).__name__}: {rule}")

custom-control-rule-shape.conditions: The KeyError and the dropped keys follow from the dictionary indexing and the fixed keys copied; they were not run.
